meta.title: CUAWright
meta.description: CUAWright (formerly Webwright) skills for DeepSeek Harness, producing Robot Framework suites instead of Python scripts. cuawright-web authors .robot cases in the conventions of the 通用自动化项目框架 v6.0 framework, drives the browser through its 网页端PW (Playwright/Browser) keywords, and writes screenshot evidence into the robot output directory; cuawright-desktop runs OSWorld-V2 Ubuntu VM tasks through the cuawright desktop CLI. The browser workflow runs on the host agent's own tools and needs no extra model API key. Turn the plugin off to remove both skills from the catalog.
